description: WinDivert, renamed so that games and anti-cheats that look for it by name miss it: bol-van's build from zapret-win-bundle, with the driver service 'Monkey' and the driver file Monkey64.sys. When installed, the zapret packages use it instead of WinDivert.
notes: Global install only, from an elevated (admin) shell: scoop install -g gesu/WinDivert-hide
While this is installed, gesu/zapret, gesu/zapret2 and gesu/zapret-discord-youtube use its WinDivert.dll and
Monkey64.sys instead of gesu/WinDivert's files (they are copied when this package is installed, updated
or uninstalled, while their winws is not running). Stop the bypass first, then install or uninstall this.
It only helps against checks for a service named 'WinDivert' or a file named WinDivert64.sys. Checks for
the driver's device or anything else still find it (see README.txt in the app folder).
Monkey64.sys is an exact copy of WinDivert64.sys 2.2.2; WinDivert.dll is rebuilt by bol-van with small patches.
pre_install: if (!$global) { error "$app puts a driver or a service on the system, which runs as SYSTEM: install it globally, so that only administrators can change its files: scoop install -g gesu/$app"; break }

if ([System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSArchitecture -eq 'Arm64') { error "$app has no ARM64 build: the WinDivert driver is x64 only (ARM64 Windows would need test signing)."; break }
# Data for other packages: the shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which says what it is for.
':: WinDivert-hide: shows what the package holds and what it is for, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO   WinDivert.dll   rebuilt so that it loads Monkey64.sys as the service Monkey',
'ECHO   Monkey64.sys    exact copy of WinDivert64.sys 2.2.2 (signed by its author)',
'ECHO While this package is installed, gesu/zapret, gesu/zapret2 and gesu/zapret-discord-youtube',
'ECHO use these two files instead of gesu/WinDivert. It hides WinDivert only from programs that',
'ECHO look for the service name WinDivert or the file name WinDivert64.sys.',
post_install: # Copy the new files to the zapret packages that use them (scripts/zapret/Sync-ZapretComponents.ps1).
# A copy fails while that package's winws runs; 'zapret-discord-youtube sync' or 'scoop update -f' redo it.
pre_uninstall: # A driver service registered from this app's folder (by windivertctl or the samples here) would keep
# pointing at deleted files: stop it, and on uninstall remove it. Services of other folders stay.
if ($cmd -eq 'uninstall') { sc.exe delete $name | Out-Null; info "Removed the '$name' driver service." }
post_uninstall: # Without this package the zapret packages go back to gesu/WinDivert's files.
